design_direction.rationale: Drybar sells the finished blowout, and with six strong photographs of hair and styling in progress, a full-bleed photo opening lets the work speak before any words do; gold pulls straight from their own room and warm lighting rather than a stock salon blue. Quiet, flush-left type keeps the name out of the way of the photograph instead of competing with it as 'wide' did last time, and reviews get raised alongside the gallery because 4.5 stars and named stylists are exactly what a walk-in customer
design_direction.signature_why: A small type block set into the corner of a full-bleed hair photo mirrors the close-up hair shots that already carry this business, without repeating the split-screen look the last site used.

testimonials.author: Morgan Rockwood
testimonials.text: Always an amazing experience! The shop itself is clean and organized, the staff is always energized and friendly! Meredith is my go to girl and always does an amazing job with my long and thick hair! And she always teaches me tips and tricks that I can do at home to keep my blowout looking fresh! I love how knowledgeable she is with the different products and personalizes what’s being used based on the current condition of my hair each visit. Highly recommend visiting this location and Meredith for your next blowout!

testimonials.author: Bren Garrett
testimonials.text:
I’ve been a member at Drybar Plano for a while now and I can honestly say this location is the best of the best. I’ve been to several other Drybar locations, but nothing compares to this one.

Every single stylist I’ve had here has been amazing. They really take their time, listen to what you want, and consistently deliver the kind of blowout you walk out feeling so good about. The atmosphere is always welcoming, clean, and just a really great experience from start to finish.

Having a membership here has been one of my favorite little self-care treats, and I actually look forward to my appointments. The team truly goes above and beyond, and it shows every single time.

Highly, highly recommend this location if you’re looking for a place you can trust to get it right every time!

testimonials.author: Abby Fenner
testimonials.text: Ryleigh was so great! Super friendly and my hair looked AMAZING!! Will definitely be back soon! Catch me with my hair done always from now on 💁🏼‍♀️✨💅🏻💃🏼 Lasted me all week!!!!! 🤩 Go see her y’all! 👏🏼👏🏼

testimonials.author: Brittany Delisle
testimonials.text: I love this dry bar — my favorite splurge!!! Ezrie is the absolute best and always makes my hair perfect and exactly what I want. I’ve been coming to her for a couple years and she never fails!! I highly recommend to everyone!!!

testimonials.author: Vanda Davis
testimonials.text:
I love this place as the stylists are all great and today Ezri did my hair and I left feeling like a new woman.  It's a fun place too with a great friendly environment!!

I go twice a week because I never want to do my own hair again! Lol!
